extraction.name: SCIENCE QA
extraction.description: A multimodal multiple-choice science question dataset containing 21,208 examples collected from elementary and high school science curricula (grades 1-12) across three subjects: natural science, social science, and language science. Questions are annotated with corresponding lectures and explanations to support chain-of-thought reasoning.
extraction.creator: Pan Lu, Swaroop Mishra, Tony Xia, Liang Qiu, Kai-Wei Chang, Song-Chun Zhu, Oyvind Tafjord, Peter Clark, Ashwin Kalyan
extraction.citeAs: Lu, P., Mishra, S., Xia, T., Qiu, L., Chang, K.-W., Zhu, S.-C., Tafjord, O., Clark, P., & Kalyan, A. (2022). Learn to Explain: Multimodal Reasoning via Thought Chains for Science Question Answering. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2022).
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Questions were sourced and downloaded from open resources managed by IXL Learning (https://www.ixl.com/), an online learning platform curated by experts in K-12 education, aligned with California Common Core Content Standards. Individual components (questions, hints, images, options, answers, lectures, and solutions) were extracted using heuristic rules.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Science problems from IXL Learning (https://www.ixl.com/), an online learning platform curated by experts in K-12 education.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Invalid questions (single choice, faulty data, duplicates) were manually removed. If multiple correct answers applied, only one was kept. Answer options were shuffled to avoid specific patterns. Semi-automated scripts were used to reformat lectures and solutions so structures like tables and lists are distinguishable from simple text. A data exploration tool was developed to review examples, and incorrect annotations were manually revised by experts.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Semi-automated scripts reformatted lectures and solutions. Newline separators (\n) in text were replaced with \\n when encoding inputs for language models. Context text was replaced with an empty string for questions without context. ViT and GPT-2 based captioning models were used to generate captions for images to serve as visual context for language models.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Questions, answers, lectures, and explanations were collected from curriculum materials on IXL Learning. Incorrect annotations were manually reviewed and revised by experts using a data exploration tool. For model evaluations, human annotators evaluated generated explanations on relevance, correctness, and completeness via Amazon Mechanical Turk.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Amazon Mechanical Turk (used for human evaluation of model-generated explanations and human baseline study); custom data exploration tool for expert revision.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Human scores for generated explanations were determined by taking a majority vote across 3 workers evaluating relevance, correctness, and completeness.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: For the human performance baseline on AMT, workers were required to have obtained a high school or higher degree and pass qualification exam examples (scoring at least 4 out of 5 correct).
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: ViT and GPT-2 image captioning model (https://huggingface.co/nlpconnect/vit-gpt2-image-captioning) used to generate image captions as visual contexts.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: None. The dataset does not contain any user usage data or personally sensitive information such as gender and race, nor personally identifiable information or offensive content.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Sourced from textbooks to diagnose multimodal understanding and multi-hop reasoning in AI systems. Beneficial for follow-up research in multimodal learning, multi-hop reasoning, and developing K-12 educational applications such as tutoring systems. The authors adhere to AI for the common good and will remove antisocial data points based on feedback.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The authors state that after careful examination, to their best knowledge, they have not found any improper content, such as pornographic information, racial remarks, or harmful social bias.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Models may fail to understand multimodal inputs due to lack of fine-grained semantics in image captions, especially for diagrams; models struggle with complex and uncommon domain knowledge (e.g., terminology or multi-step chemical processes); models may generate incorrect, irrelevant, or incomplete chains of thought.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking and evaluating multimodal reasoning, visual question answering, chain-of-thought generation, training, validation, testing, and fine-tuning AI models, as well as educational applications like tutoring systems. Non-commercial research purposes only.
